text: At start, the help list (WASD walk...) is drawn over the orange greeting text from Nana; both unreadable where they overlap

Fix1/2: on Nana's porch facing window lantern, prompt reads 'E light Nana's window lantern, for Nana's mother, Ada'; one step back it read 'come closer to light it'. Good. Prompt line wraps and overlaps NEXT text block though.
Grandpa Ike's lantern lit with E while crosshair was still on the Okafors' door (lantern not visible on screen); 2 of 4. NEXT moved on each time. Marker now '< 21 m' at left edge.
As the cat on the Okafors' porch, turned around 180 deg and looked down: no candy bag glint or label visible anywhere near where Wren stood
Fix5: as cat, walked ~2 m off the Okafors' porch and turned back: porch and lit lantern visible but no glint or 'candy bag' label where the bag was set down. HUD says '(bag on the ground)' only.

Fix5: back as Wren, NEXT says 'Fetch your candy bag from where you changed (E)'; the bag is a red box on the porch with no glint and no label until the crosshair is on it, then 'E pick up your candy bag' and E works. Candy 3 kept. Also: Grandpa Ike's jar lantern beside the pumpkin looks unlit (dark jar) even though HUD says Lanterns 2 of 4.

Quit via Esc,Esc at ~6:44 then pt stop + identical pt start: 'Loaded your save.' Clock 6:45, Candy 3, Costume pumpkin, Lanterns 2 of 4, same spot and view direction on the Okafors' porch. Nothing lost. (First Esc showed no on-screen hint that a second Esc quits.)
Marker '17 m' and the target house sit behind the left HUD block (Costume/You are lines), hard to read; walking straight at it, Wren is stopped by a low fence with no hint of a gate

F9 at 7:10 (Candy 5 after the Garcias) loads the 6:41 F5/quit save: back to 6:44, Candy 3, Okafors' porch. Works as described, but no confirmation and the message 'Loaded your save.' does not say what time it went back to; no autosave had been written in the ~75 s of game time since loading.
Fix2: at the Garcias' door, a step away and crosshair just off the door: glint on the door, orange crosshair, 'E knock: trick or treat!'. Earlier from ~4-7 m: 'come closer to knock'. Clear.

Before crash test: 7:31 pm, Candy 8, pumpkin, Lanterns 2 of 4, on Ms. Bright's porch. Last autosave file written 20:42:37 (before the Ms. Bright knock). No on-screen 'saved' cue seen for the autosave.

pt stop with no quit at 7:31 (Candy 8), then identical pt start: 'Loaded your save.' 7:35 pm, Candy 8, 5 to go, pumpkin, Lanterns 2 of 4, same spot facing Ms. Bright's door. Nothing lost (clock even a few minutes later than when killed: the save was written during the pt note just before stop).
Notebook (Tab) after two reloads still holds the Samhain page; text fills to the bottom edge with no visible page number or Left/Right hint, may be cut off
